text:
### Transparency  
**Privacy Notice Provided At:**
- Account opening (mandatory)
- Online/mobile app signup
- Website (public notice)
- On request  
**Privacy Notice Contains:**
- Data controller identity (FirstUK Bank)
- Processing purposes
- Lawful basis
- Data retention period
- Customer rights
- Contact for data queries  
---
name: Chunk 10/36

raw_entities.name: Privacy Notice Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the provision and content of privacy notices to customers at key touchpoints including account opening, online signup, and on request. Establishes mandatory disclosure of data controller identity, processing purposes, lawful basis, retention periods, customer rights, and data query contact information.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: Account opening (mandatory)
Privacy Notice Contains: Data controller identity (FirstUK Bank)
Processing purposes
Data retention period
Customer rights

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Privacy Notice at Account Opening
raw_entities.description: Requirement that a privacy notice must be provided to customers at the point of account opening. This is explicitly marked as a mandatory disclosure obligation.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: Account opening (mandatory)

raw_entities.name: Privacy Notice Provision at Online and Mobile App Signup
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must be made available to customers during online and mobile application signup processes.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: Online/mobile app signup

raw_entities.name: Privacy Notice Publication on Website
raw_entities.description: Requirement that a privacy notice be published as a public notice on the bank's website for general access.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: Website (public notice)

raw_entities.name: Privacy Notice Provision on Customer Request
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must be provided to customers upon request at any time.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: On request

raw_entities.name: Data Controller Identity Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must disclose the identity of the data controller, identified as FirstUK Bank.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Data controller identity (FirstUK Bank)

raw_entities.name: Processing Purposes Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must clearly disclose the purposes for which customer personal data is processed.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Processing purposes

raw_entities.name: Lawful Basis Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must disclose the lawful basis upon which the bank processes customer personal data.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Lawful basis

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Period Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must disclose the period for which customer personal data is retained.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Data retention period

raw_entities.name: Customer Rights Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must disclose the rights available to customers regarding their personal data.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Customer rights

raw_entities.name: Data Query Contact Information Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Requirement that privacy notices must provide contact information for customers to direct data-related queries and requests.
context: Privacy Notice Contains: Contact for data queries

raw_entities.name: Data Privacy Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of non-compliance with data protection obligations and failure to provide transparent notice to customers regarding personal data processing, retention, and customer rights.
context: Privacy Notice Provided At: Account opening (mandatory)
Privacy Notice Contains: Data controller identity (FirstUK Bank)

raw_entities.description: The data controller and policy owner responsible for implementing privacy notice requirements and disclosing personal data processing activities to customers.
